text: Opening, 1 minute. The target is time-varying Spearman copula dependence. The problem is memory: too little history gives noisy estimates; too much history causes lag. Today I will show the mathematics, the synthetic evidence, and what the adaptive method actually achieved. Source: notes/studies/results_2026_09_22.md and manuscript.md.

text: 2 minutes. The producer and broker already publish paired synthetic observations as two per-symbol ticks. The standalone consumer reconstructs returns and runs online estimators. The reported adaptive-memory results come from experiments/probe_adaptive.cpp, not the browser or a live feed. The live consumer currently runs fixed Xiao and Hermite variants; connecting the new banks is future work. Source: src/streamgenerator/main.cpp, src/consumer/device_state.hpp, experiments/probe_adaptive.cpp.

3 minutes. This is the analytical approximation, not a fit to the experiment. For locally linear drift with slope d, variance decreases as 1/M and squared lag bias grows as (dM/2)^2. Their sum has an interior optimum; for a jump, this local linear approximation is not exact. The chart uses σ²=1 and d=0.0005 solely to illustrate the shape. Source: notes/studies/memory_sweep.md; notes/studies/rate_budget.md.

2 minutes. Each method has its own parameterization. Xiao and Gaussian MLE use a retention λ, with α approximately 1−λ. Hermite uses λ as the update weight. Kalman has a gain implied by process and observation variance. Converting all of them to nominal effective memory creates one comparison axis. In 20 of 24 scenario-window-family cells, Xiao and Gaussian MLE picked the same best memory. This does not mean their errors are identical. Source: notes/studies/results_2026_09_22.md sections 1 and 9; notes/studies/memory_sweep.md section 9.

title: The parametric advantage depends on the family

text: The parametric advantage depends on the family

text: 2 minutes. The Gaussian MLE is well specified on Gaussian-copula data and beats Xiao in all six windows. Across the other three generating families it wins 9 of 18 cells, with a worst observed increase in loss of 66.7% on Clayton. The argument for nonparametric Xiao is robustness to unknown family, not that it always has the smallest error. Data: notes/studies/results_2026_09_22.md section 2, from memory_sweep.md section 9.
Thinning beat batching at equal budget in the tested cases.

text: 2 minutes. Here f is the fraction of incoming ticks the estimator processes, not the broker rate limit. An observation memory M spans M/f wall-clock ticks. On linear drift, minimizing σ²/(f M_ticks)+(d M_ticks/2)^2 gives M*_ticks proportional to f^(-1/3). Measured ratios were 1.25 at f=1/2 and 1.67 at f=1/4; predictions 1.26 and 1.59. This law is not expected to hold exactly at jumps. Thinning beat contiguous batching by 1.3 to 8.4 percent in the tested settings. Source: notes/studies/rate_budget.md.

text: 3 minutes. Each bank runs the same estimator at several forgetting rates. The generic bank scores each arm by pre-update squared rank residual, applies exponential weights, and adds fixed-share weight so an arm can recover. It reports a weighted rho and posterior-mean memory. This plot uses the actual seed-averaged Xiao bank trajectory on the Gaussian jump experiment. It first favours long memory, then contracts after the change. The worst-case regret ratio compares candidate policies over four synthetic scenarios; it is not a real-feed result or a universal guarantee. Data: experiments/results/adaptive_memory_traj.csv; notes/studies/results_2026_09_22.md sections 4 and 9.

title: The whole-run gain is earned before the jump

text: The whole-run gain is earned before the jump
textPreview: The whole-run gain is earned before the jump

text: 3 minutes. This is seed-averaged cumulative squared error against one best fixed Xiao arm selected over the complete jump run. Negative means the bank is ahead. The bank gains 7,647 ×10^-3 before the jump, then loses 4,860 ×10^-3 in recovery and another 905 ×10^-3 after settling; rounded values sum to about −1,881 ×10^-3 overall. Thus the whole-run result conceals the very period where rapid adaptation matters. This is why the talk reports time decomposition as well as scalar regret. Source: notes/studies/results_2026_09_22.md section 6 and notes/studies/adaptive_memory.md section 15.

text: 2 minutes. The contribution is empirical: a common memory axis, a measured bias-variance and rate tradeoff, and a time-resolved assessment of memory selection. The bank algorithms themselves are established forms of exponential weights or multiple-model averaging plus fixed share. The live integration remains to be done. On real trades there is no latent rho for RMSE or truth-based regret. Asynchronous sampling can change measured correlation without a change in latent dependence, so the real-feed demonstration must show trade intensity and price age alongside mean memory. Sources: notes/studies/results_2026_09_22.md; notes/studies/online_study_protocol.md; Epps (1979) https://doi.org/10.1080/01621459.1979.10482508; Zhang (2011) https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jeconom.2010.03.012.
